snippet.title: DozyInGracklelandCommercial
snippet.description:
You can play the Demo here:
https://jugglingdino.itch.io/grackleland

On top of making this platformer, it was super fun to learn to record and make this video. I was trying to capture the vibe of a videogame ad from the 90s. Do you think I hit the mark?

The full digital release is March 20th, the first day of Spring. 
After that I plan on producing a physical cartridge, complete with a box and manual. 

I hope you dig this, lemme know what you think in the comments!
